title: Who picked this for you?
caption:
Outlets choose what to cover. Platforms recommend what to show. Readers navigate the choices in between.

The Daily Nun examined the evidence behind media ownership, algorithms, and civic influence.

Full report + sources:

sources.title: On YouTube's recommendation system
sources.author: Cristos Goodrow
sources.limits: Explains the company's described recommendation signals in 2021. It is not an independent audit of every app or a claim that a feed determines a person's beliefs. The report contains the wider research and its limitations.
